Gate_8A_protocol_integrity.description: Train/test strictly separated; checkpoint frozen; normalizer fit on train only; no test leakage

Gate_8B_zero_shot_prediction.description: Zero-shot prediction quality on unseen scene
Gate_8B_zero_shot_prediction.note: If rho_learned <= 0, model has no zero-shot transfer signal

Gate_8C_zero_shot_selection.description: Budget selection quality on unseen scene
Gate_8C_zero_shot_selection.pass_criterion: delta_q_learned >= delta_q_error_only at majority of budgets
Gate_8C_zero_shot_selection.note: Phase 7 found no advantage on in-domain; zero-shot may be worse

Gate_8D_transfer_robustness.note: No pass/fail — this is a measurement gate. Reports how much performance degrades under distribution shift.
